title: Femminielli — Debut Album Now Streaming on Bandcamp
summary: The debut Femminielli album is now available to stream and download on Bandcamp. Dream-experimental sound from the edges of the network.
body:
The debut Femminielli album is now live on Bandcamp. Operating at the edges of the network where signal becomes noise becomes art — this release is fragile, layered, and impossible to pin down.

Listen and download at [moonlightsparkle.bandcamp.com](https://moonlightsparkle.bandcamp.com).
